question.description: The question for the person. Example: Ship the beta tonight?

choices.description: Optional answers, up to 5 unique strings. Example: ["yes", "no"].

to.description: Who to ask: owner or requester. requester needs handoff_id. Example: owner.

handoff_id.description: The hnd_... id; needed when to is requester. Example: hnd_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the answer. Example: 0.
